lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible across the lateral flank. A central triad of spots forms a scalene triangular arrangement, while three larger, high-intensity centroids are positioned in a near-vertical column further posterior.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features run across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a high-luminance upper boundary and a low-luminance shadow immediately below, creating a sharp vertical intensity gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical, high-luminance linear feature is visible approximately one gill-width posterior to the fifth gill slit, extending from the dorsal-lateral region toward the ventral area.
